item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.4.0

Added SportsData.io integration with provider-agnostic architecture for browsing CBB, NBA, and MLB teams, players, stats, and schedules. Attach sports data as character knowledge sources with manual and auto-refresh support. Improved onboarding with Supabase setup wizard and character creation flow.
